# MediaFlow Studio 1.3.0 — Four new tools: Compressor, Auto-Cut, GIF & Stickers, Inspector

## ✨ New

### 🗜️ Compressor: fit a video into a size
- Drop videos and pick a target for each one: **8 MB**, **20 MB · Discord**, **25 MB · E-mail**, 50 MB, 100 MB, or **your own size** in MB.
- MediaFlow works out the bitrate from the duration and encodes in **two passes**: the file **never goes over** the limit, and the space is spent where the picture needs it.
- When the size is small, the resolution steps down on its own (a sharp 720p beats a blocky 1080p).
- Each file shows the bitrate its size allows before you start. If a video is too long for the size, you're told the smallest size that works.
- A video that already fits is never made bigger.

### 🔇 Auto-Cut: silences removed for you
- Drop a rush, a podcast or a tutorial: MediaFlow finds the silences and keeps only what is said.
- Adjust the level (-20 dB for a noisy room → -50 dB for a studio), how long a silence must last, and how much breathing room to keep around each cut.
- Three ways out:
  - **Cut file**: the video (or audio) without the silences, cut on the exact frame.
  - **XML · Premiere / Resolve**: a timeline that opens in Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve with every cut in place on your original media, so you can still adjust each one.
  - **EDL timeline**: the classic CMX 3600 list, with your file's own timecode.

### 🎞️ GIF & Stickers
- Turn a passage of a video into a **GIF** or an **animated WebP** (stickers, web, chats).
- GIFs get a colour palette made for that very clip: **no grain, no banding**.
- Pick the start time, the length, 10 to 30 fps, a maximum height (never enlarged) and the loop.

### 🔍 Inspector & metadata cleaner
- Drop any video, audio file or photo to see **everything it says about itself**: container, codecs and profiles, resolution, colour space and HDR, bitrates, audio channels, creation date, every tag, and the EXIF / XMP of photos.
- **Private details are flagged in orange**: GPS position, phone or camera model, dates, software…
- **Clean metadata** makes a copy without them, in a second:
  - videos and audio are copied as they are, with no re-encoding and no quality loss;
  - JPEG, PNG and WebP keep their picture untouched, and photos keep their orientation.
- **Copy report** puts the whole sheet on the clipboard, ready to paste to a client or a support request.

## 💡 Improved

- All four tools work like the others: drop several files, see what each one will become, cancel at any time, then **drag the result** straight into Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.
- Everything is translated into the **9 languages** of the app.
- The sidebar scrolls when the window is short, so all 9 tools stay within reach.

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically: click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
